source.name: SecSkills
source.role: Curated capability index; not an endorsement or auto-install list

need_when: reviewing a plugin or MCP package
prompt instructions or scripts come from an untrusted source
the target is an agent, chatbot, RAG system, multi-agent workflow, or MCP-enabled application
multiple findings can enable a chain
the work needs explicit facts and intents across sessions
evaluation: one actionable intent at a time

need_when: a model-produced signal looks plausible but impact is not proven
large source or artifact inventories need consistent enumeration
evaluation: LLM filters context and false positives

need_when: the authorized artifact is an APK, IPA, or mini-program package
the authorized artifact is a native binary or protected mobile package
authorized source code is available and black-box testing is insufficient

selection_rules: Prefer the existing built-in guarded tool over adding another autonomous platform.
Do not install a third-party Skill before src_skill_audit and human review.
External projects are candidates, not trusted dependencies.
A capability that adds a new network, credential, or tool-execution boundary requires explicit approval.
Never replace the local evidence gate with a vendor's claimed zero-false-positive result.
